capabilities: Trigger a searchable file-link suggestion menu with b[ or a command
Sort suggestions by incoming link count in the vault
Boost specific files via a frontmatter key
Optionally show boost score calculations in the suggestion interface
extras: Manual installation steps are documented; the README notes the repo lacks automated tests and asks for help with end-to-end testing.
intentEvidence: Alternative inline link suggester that orders results by link count and manual boosts.
motivation: The author built it because the core suggester ignores how often files are linked to, causing users typing quickly to pick less-frequently-linked files that appear higher in the list.
problem: Obsidian's built-in link suggestions rank files only by search match, so frequently linked files can be buried below alphabetically earlier ones and chosen by mistake when writing quickly.

relations.evidence: If you have the Obsidian Tasks plugin installed and enabled, using the Tasks' plugin's default settings, link suggestions will not appear

summary: Link suggester triggered by b[ that orders file suggestions by incoming link count plus manual boost scores from frontmatter.
